{{Quote|Go to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Your training is far from complete, my Apprentice.|Darth Vader|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
The '''First Mission to the Jedi Temple''' was an assignment carried out by [[Galen Marek]], to complete his training in preparation of facing several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Assignment==
{{Quote|You lack focus. You're easily distracted. Had that been your own saber you would be dead by now.|Darth Vader chides Starkiller after defeating Kota|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
After Marek defeated [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] in the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent his apprentice to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in order to prepare for his [[First mission to Raxus Prime|next mission]], largely because Vader deduced that Starkiller lacked focus after an incident where Vader nearly killed Marek with Kota's lightsaber to test him.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

===Infiltrating the Temple===
{{Quote|This area is strictly off-limits by order of the Emperor! Return to your ship immediately.|An Imperial Navy commando confronts Starkiller upon his arrival|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
Upon the ''Rogue Shadow'' touching down on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] landing pad that had been erected on the staircase of the entrance to the Temple, the [[Imperial Navy commando]]s stationed near the entrance attempted to order Marek to return to the ''Rogue Shadow'' immediately, as the Jedi Temple had been decreed strictly off-limits to outsiders. However, Marek defeated the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]] standing guard there. Entering through the damaged Main Hall, Marek fought his way through more Imperials, including members of the [[Imperial Senate Sentinel]]s,<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" /> a subdivision of the [[Imperial Senate Guard/Legends|Imperial Senate Guard]],<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> to one of the upper level corridors. The entrance to the library being sealed, the Sith apprentice retreated into a hallway that was blocked by debris from the ceiling.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

===Trial of Skill===
[[File:Jedi_Trials_Chamber.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Marek enters the Jedi Trials chamber.]]
{{Quote|Your time is over, I am the future of the Sith!|Starkiller to Darth Desolous|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
Walking down a corridor, Marek entered the largely intact [[Jedi Trials chamber|Jedi Trials Chamber]]. Once within it, his presence activated the Jedi training program modeled after the long-dead Sith Lord, [[Darth Desolous]]. Leeching off Marek's fear, the Desolous program began his attack, wielding a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] shield and a red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

Marek successfully fended off the hologram's lightsaber blows and used [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] to send the program reeling. Though the Desolous program imitated the original Sith Lord's very powerful usage of the Force, it was no match for the raw power that Vader's apprentice possessed. Hurling pieces of the surrounding statues at his adversary, Marek eventually wore down the avatar's defenses.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

Near defeat, the Desolous program made a final attempt at destroying Marek, and failed. Marek then used the Force to hurl Desolous's hologram towards the main statue at the top of the hall, and up along the statue's surface. The program was then cast down from the statue's face and hurled into the stone floor. With a final pull of the Force, the [[Statue of Emperor Palpatine|main statue]] came crumbling down on the hologram of the ancient Sith Lord, defeating him and ending the Trials program.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|My spies have located another Jedi. I do not expect you to survive. Kazdan Paratus is far more powerful than you. But if you destroy him, you'll be one step closer to your destiny.''"<br />"''The Emperor.''"<br />"''Yes. Only together can we defeat him.''"<br />"''I will not fail you Master.|Darth Vader sends Starkiller on his next mission|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />}}
Immediately after the training program had ended, [[PROXY]], Marek's [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] companion, entered the room. Marek was confused as to why PROXY was present, although after PROXY's holodroid functions turned him into Darth Vader, Marek proceeded to automatically fall down on one knee in homage to him. Vader then informed him that his spies have located the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kazdan Paratus]], and that while he doubts due to Paratus' abilities that Starkiller will defeat him, he will come closer to reaching his destiny of killing [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] if he does succeed in doing so. Vowing not to fail his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], Marek then left the Temple to begin his hunt for Paratus.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (video game)" />

==Behind the scenes==
This mission is only available for the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 2|PlayStation 2]], [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PlayStation Portable]], and [[Wikipedia:Wii|Wii]] versions of [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|The Force Unleashed]]. On the [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] and [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] versions, Starkiller will head straight to [[First mission to Raxus Prime|Raxus Prime]] after the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|TIE Fighter Construction Facility]]
